{"node-1787856322649":{"S3DirectTarget":{"AutoDataQuality":{"EvaluationContext":"EvaluateDataQuality_node1787843854341","IsEnabled":true},"Compression":"none","Format":"csv","Inputs":["node-1787855130543"],"Name":"Amazon S3","NumberTargetPartitions":"1","PartitionKeys":[],"Path":"s3://global-partners-oseikwadwo/gold/customer-churn-indicators/","SchemaChangePolicy":{"EnableUpdateCatalog":false}}},"node-1787855048108":{"S3CsvSource":{"AdditionalOptions":{"EnableSamplePath":false,"SamplePath":"s3://global-partners-oseikwadwo/silver/order_items/run-1787708185380-part-r-00000"},"Escaper":"","Exclusions":[],"Name":"Amazon S3","OptimizePerformance":false,"OutputSchemas":[{"Columns":[{"Name":"app_name","Type":"string"},{"Name":"restaurant_id","Type":"string"},{"Name":"creation_time_utc","Type":"string"},{"Name":"order_id","Type":"string"},{"Name":"user_id","Type":"string"},{"Name":"printed_card_number","Type":"string"},{"Name":"is_loyalty","Type":"string"},{"Name":"currency","Type":"string"},{"Name":"lineitem_id","Type":"string"},{"Name":"item_category","Type":"string"},{"Name":"item_name","Type":"string"},{"Name":"item_price","Type":"string"},{"Name":"item_quantity","Type":"string"},{"Name":"formatted_date","Type":"string"},{"Name":"rounded_price","Type":"string"}]}],"Paths":["s3://global-partners-oseikwadwo/silver/order_items/run-1787708185380-part-r-00000"],"QuoteChar":"quote","Recurse":true,"Separator":"comma","WithHeader":true}},"node-1787855130543":{"SparkSQL":{"Inputs":["node-1787855048108"],"Name":"SQL Query","OutputSchemas":[{"Columns":[{"Name":"user_id","Type":"string"},{"Name":"days_since_last_order","Type":"int"},{"Name":"avg_gap_days","Type":"double"},{"Name":"pct_change_spend","Type":"double"},{"Name":"inactivity_tag","Type":"string"}]}],"SqlAliases":[{"Alias":"myDataSource","From":"node-1787855048108"}],"SqlQuery":"WITH Order_Sequence AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        formatted_date,
        SUM(item_price) as order_spend,
        LAG(formatted_date) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY formatted_date ASC) as prev_order_date
    FROM myDataSource
    GROUP BY user_id, formatted_date
),

Customer_Gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), MAX(formatted_date)) as days_since_last_order,
        AVG(DATEDIFF(formatted_date, prev_order_date)) as avg_gap_days,
        

        SUM(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN order_spend END) as current_period_spend,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN order_spend END) as previous_period_spend
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY formatted_date DESC) as order_rank
        FROM Order_Sequence
    )
    GROUP BY user_id
),

Calculated_Metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        days_since_last_order,
        COALESCE(avg_gap_days, 0) as avg_gap_days,
        current_period_spend,
        previous_period_spend,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(previous_period_spend, 0) = 0 THEN NULL 
            ELSE ((current_period_spend - previous_period_spend) / previous_period_spend) * 100 
        END as pct_change_spend
    FROM Customer_Gaps
)

SELECT 
    user_id,
    days_since_last_order,
    avg_gap_days,
    pct_change_spend,
    CASE 
        WHEN days_since_last_order > 90 THEN 'Churned'
        WHEN days_since_last_order > 45 THEN 'At Risk'
        WHEN days_since_last_order > 30 THEN 'Needs Attention'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END as inactivity_tag
FROM Calculated_Metrics;
"}}}
